subject: Announcing General Availability of Analytics v2!

subject: Urgent: Acme Corp billing discrepancy
body: Hi Support Team, we signed our Enterprise agreement today with Marcus confirming a 35% discount tier. However, our billing dashboard still lists the standard $10,000/month recurring invoice. Can you update our tier before the invoice drafts?
